resources.string: A paid ad the creator reads inside the video.
The creator promoting their own products, store or other channels.
Asking you to like, subscribe or comment in the middle of the video.
An opening sequence or a recurring break with no content.
Clips of what\'s coming up, or a recap of what came before.
Greetings and teasers at the start that carry no information.
Side talk or jokes off the video\'s topic.
In music videos: the parts that aren\'t music.
Shasha skips these parts automatically in every profile, with a small notice.
Nothing is skipped: Shasha won\'t ask SponsorBlock about any video.
